annotations.annotation_text: Viconian philosophical framework: Giambattista Vico's three spiral ages (the divine/theocratic, heroic/aristocratic, and human/democratic) followed by the ricorso (dissolution and restart), reflected here in "divine".
sources: Vico, Giambattista. Scienza Nuova (The New Science, 1725). https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
Beckett, Samuel, et al. Our Exagmination Round His Factification... https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
